name: My Best Deal
source:
Saving a girl from certain death a young man finds himself in heaven where he cuts a deal with the goddess of love.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pirotking]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻男子救下了一位命悬一线的女孩，自己却来到了天堂，并在那里与爱之女神达成了一笔交易。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Pirotking]Patreon[/url]]
